watch.summary: The streamer realizes he needs to download a custom map mod on Steam before starting a lobby and follows the on-screen prompts.

beats.what: Streamer gets confused by a pop-up saying a mod must be downloaded.
He reads the prompt and clicks through to open the Steam Workshop.
He subscribes to download the Police Station map.
He switches back to the game lobby where the download is confirmed.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: This clip consists purely of administrative lobby setup as the creator navigates a Steam Workshop download. There is no joke or comedic punchline present.
